Alert:
import { Alert } from '@northwind/ui'

A message about the page or a task. Wraps MUI Alert (standard style only).

Props
• severity?: info | success | warning | error (default info)
    How serious the message is.
    - info: useful to know.
    - success: something worked.
    - warning: may need action.
    - error: something failed and needs action.
• title?. In Figma: text "titleText" + toggle "title"
    Optional bold first line.
• children. In Figma: text "message"
    The message. Say what happened and what to do next.
• onClose?. In Figma: toggle "onClose"
    Shows a close button. Leave out for messages that must stay visible.

Button:
import { Button } from '@northwind/ui'

Triggers an action. Wraps MUI Button with Northwind's four variants.

Props
• children. In Figma: text "label"
    The label. Use sentence case and a verb: "Save changes", "Export CSV".
• variant?: primary | secondary | ghost | danger (default primary)
    What the button is for.
    - primary: the main action. Use at most one per area.
    - secondary: other actions next to a primary one.
    - ghost: low-emphasis actions, often in toolbars or lists.
    - danger: destructive actions such as Delete. Ask for confirmation first.
• size?: small | medium (default medium)
• startIcon?. In Figma: icon "↳ startIcon" + toggle "startIcon"
    Icon before the label.
• endIcon?. In Figma: icon "↳ endIcon" + toggle "endIcon"
    Icon after the label.
• loading?: true | false. Not in Figma yet
    Shows a spinner and disables the button while an action runs.
• disabled?: true | false. In Figma: state=disabled

DataTable:
import { DataTable } from '@northwind/ui'

Rows of records with sortable columns. Wraps the free MUI X Data Grid (Community).
Use it for lists people compare or scan: inspections, sites, permits. For two or three items, use Cards.

In Figma: fill the Header slot with DataTable/HeaderCell instances and the Rows slot with rows of
DataTable/Cell instances, in the same column order. Figma's columns are equal width; code uses grow.

Props
• rows. In Figma: slot "Rows"
    One object per row. Each needs a unique id, e.g.
    { id: 'i-106', site: 'Antwerp yard', date: '2026-10-29T09:30', result: { status: 'neutral', label: 'Pending' } }.
• columns. In Figma: slot "Header"
    One object per column, in display order:
    { field: string; header: string; type?: 'text' | 'number' | 'date' | 'status'; grow?: 1 | 2 | 3 }.
    field names a row property. date values are a Date or ISO string; status values are { status, label }
    (the StatusLabel props). grow is the column's share of spare width. E.g.
    [{ field: 'site', header: 'Site', grow: 2 }, { field: 'date', header: 'Date', type: 'date' }, { field: 'result', header: 'Result', type: 'status' }].
• loading?: true | false (default false). In Figma: state=loading
    Shows a loading bar while rows are being fetched.
• emptyMessage? (default Nothing to show yet.)
    Shown when there are no rows. Say what's missing and, if you can, why.
• density?: standard | compact (default standard)
    Row height. compact fits more rows on dense screens.

StatusLabel:
import { StatusLabel } from '@northwind/ui'

Shows the status of a record, for example in a table row. Not clickable.
Built on MUI Chip. (MUI's Badge is a notification counter, not a status label.)

Props
• label
    Short, self-describing text: "Approved", "Overdue", "Pending review". Not just "OK".
• status?: neutral | info | success | warning | error (default neutral)
    The state the label reports.
    - neutral: waiting, draft, not started.
    - info: in progress or for information.
    - success: done, approved, healthy.
    - warning: needs attention soon.
    - error: failed, blocked, overdue.

TextField:
import { TextField } from '@northwind/ui'

Single-line text input with a label. Wraps MUI TextField (outlined only).

In Figma: the helperText toggle shows the hint line; edit its words in the layer.
Hover and focus are Figma-only states; code handles them itself.

Props
• label
    Visible label. Always give one; placeholders are not labels.
• value?. In Figma: text "value" + toggle "showValue"
    Controlled value. Use with onChange.
• helperText?. In Figma: toggle "helperText"
    Hint under the field. When error is true, say what is wrong and how to fix it.
• error?: true | false. In Figma: state=error
    Shows the field in the error state. Pair it with helperText.
• required?: true | false
• disabled?: true | false. In Figma: state=disabled
• placeholder?. In Figma: text "placeholder" + toggle "showPlaceholder"
    Example input, shown when empty. Not a replacement for label.
